name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: Prvni verejny WDUi Framework SDK balicek: proprietarni binarni x64 SDK s hlavickami, wdui.lib, default skiny/fonty, binarnim demo a otevrenou ukazkou pouziti bez zdrojovych cpp souboru knihovny.
changes_en: First public WDUi Framework SDK package: proprietary binary x64 SDK with headers, wdui.lib, default skins/fonts, binary demo, and an open usage example without library cpp sources.
